sloka: स याच्यमानो गुरुणा मया च दृढविक्रम: ।राघव: परमप्रीतो वसिष्ठं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ २.११३.९॥
transliteration: sa yācyamāno guruṇā mayā ca dṛḍhavikrama: ।rāghava: paramaprīto vasiṣṭhaṁ vākyamabravīt ॥ 2.113.9॥

translations.english: Entreated by me and by preceptor (Vasistha), the highly pleased Rama with his firmness of mind replied to Vasistha:
